categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies src/torcontrol.cpp, which manages the Tor daemon integration and is explicitly covered under P2P.
categories.rationale: Demotes Tor control port reconnection warnings to debug level to prevent log pollution on default node setups without a running Tor daemon. The PR description notes that since v32, 'every failed reconnect attempt logs... this pollutes debug.log with 18 lines every hour.'
